headline: Quarterly revenue growth was uneven, with a few firms posting very high gains while the larger players slowed.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. Mid‑tier firms such as LTM, Tech Mahindra and Mphasis delivered solid double‑digit growth. The large‑cap peers Infosys and TCS saw growth in the low‑teens, and Infosys trimmed its FY27 guidance. Profitability was mixed, with Infosys and HCLTech posting strong profit jumps, while Wipro’s net profit slipped.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several companies highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure at the top end
themes.detail: Despite revenue growth, Infosys cut its FY27 guidance and Wipro’s operating margin slipped, indicating cost pressures.
